propositions: Five experiment artifacts cited in merged tickets and in criteria_routing.json _comment fields do not exist on origin/main, leaving dangling citations and inaccessible provenance records.

The calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, code-review-threshold-calibration.md, escaped_bug_analysis.py, escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md, and write_parity_oracle_prototype.py files are already-written deliverables from closed tickets cranial-goodly-seahog and restoring-shallow-blobfish and exist only in one untracked worktree checkout.

Landing the five files into docs/experiments/ (an established directory for investigation artifacts outside lint sources and packaged wheel) resolves all dangling citations and restores the empirical basis for code-review-threshold tuning and write-parity oracle design.
